method_summary: Direct successor identity is taken from the two independent Census Bureau change records. 2024 TIGER confirms current target identifiers/classes. Existing 2018-to-2024 area overlaps are reported only as a separate inherited screen.
uncertainties: The 2019 Census change reports establish two successor Census Areas but do not certify that their 2024 TIGER polygons form a byte-exact partition of the earlier 2018 geoBoundaries polygon.
The #486 overlay records four tiny ancillary 2024 county-equivalent overlaps; they are not interpreted as additional official successors.
Census Area identifiers are county-equivalent statistical geography and do not independently adjudicate local political control, municipal government, or historical sovereignty.
